newsitem.title: USA: CET finalizes $292 mln of cleanup contracts.
newsitem.headline: CET finalizes $292 mln of cleanup contracts.

text.p: CET Environmental Services Inc Wednesday said it finalized and signed the Emergency and Rapid Response Services West Contract for the Environmental Protection Agency Regions 6, 8, and 9 awarded the company in December.
The contract capacity originally estimated at $250 million was increased to $292 million and includes work in 15 states throughout the western region of the United States.

John Hopkins, senior vice president and director of government programs at CET said the increase in final contract value, "signifies the vast amount of critical cleanup work to be performed over the next few years and the confidence the EPA has in the CET team." Hopkins added, "CET will begin to see a large increase in EPA work volume immediately."

CET is also bidding on similar contracts in EPA Regions 4 and 10 for work in the Southeastern and Pacific Northwest U.S., respectively. These contracts total approximately $75 million in combined value.
CET has offices in 10 states and conducts business in environmental remediation, water treatment, and emergency responses.
